description: JSON error output and exit codes of keeper subcommands when piped.

steps.command: for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys j >/dev/null; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui text | sed -n '28p'; done; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui show | sed -n '9,14p' | cat -v
.bugpatrol/sandbox/tui resize 100 30 >/dev/null; sleep 1; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys t >/dev/null; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui text | tail -6
.bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys a >/dev/null; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui text | sed -n '1,4p;28,30p'; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys t >/dev/null; sleep 4; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui text | sed -n '1,4p;28,30p'
.bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys a >/dev/null; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys Enter; sleep 4; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui text

K=.bugpatrol/sandbox/keeper; for c in "bogus" "scan --category nope" "scan --stale-days abc" "apply nosuchplan --yes" "undo deadbeef" "hold /tmp/keeper-patrol/home" "release /tmp/keeper-patrol/home/nothing" "plan --max-risk high" "purge --older-days -1"; do echo "== $c"; $K $c | cat; echo "exit=${pipestatus[1]}"; done 2>&1

bash -c 'K=.bugpatrol/sandbox/keeper; for c in "bogus" "apply nosuchplan --yes" "undo deadbeef" "release /tmp/keeper-patrol/home/nothing" "plan" "status" "log"; do $K $c >/tmp/keeper-patrol/o.txt 2>/tmp/keeper-patrol/e.txt; echo "== $c exit=$? stdout=$(head -c 300 /tmp/keeper-patrol/o.txt) stderr=$(head -c 200 /tmp/keeper-patrol/e.txt)"; done'
